title: Mitigating Cultural Bias in LLMs via Multi-Agent Cultural Debate

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on the CEBiasBench (a bilingual Chinese-English benchmark covering everyday cultural domains) and the Arabic CAMeL benchmark. Bias is measured using a single LLM-as-judge and a Multi-Agent Vote (MAV) protocol to classify outputs into specific cultural preference categories (e.g., Western, East Asian, African, Middle Eastern, or other) versus an explicit 'No Bias' (culturally neutral) category.
